chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Isḥāq ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā ibn Daryāb, who said:
I entered upon Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام after the passing of Abū Jaʿfar, so I offered him condolences over him, while Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام was sitting.
Then Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام wept, so Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام turned toward him and said to him: “Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has placed in you a successor from him, so praise Allah.”

key_terms.مُضِيِّ: passing away or departure through death

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the succession of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام after Abū Jaʿfar?
ai.summary: This narration describes a moment after the death of Abū Jaʿfar, when Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام consoled and addressed Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام. It indicates divine appointment and succession within the line of the Imams, while also showing grief, consolation, and gratitude to Allah.
